blocks.zh: 8.1 導論
blocks.en: 8.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 章節架構總覽
blocks.en: Chapter Overview

blocks.zh: 本章是 ISPE Volume 4 中最具實務價值的章節之一，涵蓋了從「水怎麼存」到「水怎麼送」的完整設計思維。核心內容包括：
blocks.en: This is one of the most practical chapters in ISPE Volume 4. It covers the full design thinking from "how to store the water" to "how to deliver it". The core content includes:

blocks.zh: 8 種配水系統架構 — 從批次式到連續式，從熱儲存到常溫儲存
blocks.en: 8 distribution system configurations - from batch to continuous, and from hot storage to ambient storage

blocks.zh: 決策樹 — 幫助工程師根據使用需求選擇最佳架構
blocks.en: Decision tree - helps engineers select the best configuration based on use requirements

blocks.zh: 材料比較 — 不銹鋼 vs. PVDF 的全面對比
blocks.en: Material comparison - a full comparison of stainless steel vs. PVDF

blocks.zh: 系統元件 — 熱交換器、呼吸過濾器、泵浦、閥門的設計要點
blocks.en: System components - design points for heat exchangers, vent filters, pumps and valves

blocks.zh: 比喻：城市供水系統
blocks.en: Analogy: a city water supply

blocks.zh: 想像一座製藥廠就像一座小型城市 — 儲水槽是水塔，配水迴路是自來水管線，使用點是各家各戶的水龍頭。設計的核心挑戰就是：如何確保每個水龍頭打開時，都能得到符合品質要求的水，同時不浪費太多能源和金錢。
blocks.en: Think of a pharmaceutical plant as a small city: the storage tank is the water tower, the distribution loop is the water main, and the points of use are the household taps. The core design challenge is this: how do you make sure that every tap, when opened, delivers water that meets the quality requirements, without wasting too much energy and money?

blocks.zh: 8.2 系統設計
blocks.en: 8.2 System Design

blocks.zh: 儲水槽的核心價值
blocks.en: The core value of the storage tank

blocks.zh: 儲水槽的主要功能是緩衝（buffering）— 將前處理系統的穩定產水與生產端的瞬間大量用水需求解耦。沒有儲水槽，前處理系統必須能應對最大瞬時需求，設備會非常昂貴。
blocks.en: The main function of a storage tank is buffering - decoupling the steady output of the pretreatment system from the instantaneous high water demand of production. Without a storage tank, the pretreatment system would have to handle the peak instantaneous demand, and the equipment would be very expensive.

blocks.zh: 優點：降低前處理設備規模、提供應急儲備、分區隔離
blocks.en: Advantages: smaller pretreatment equipment, emergency reserve, zonal isolation

blocks.zh: 缺點：資本成本高、引入低流速死水區域、增加微生物風險
blocks.en: Disadvantages: high capital cost, introduces low-flow stagnant areas, increases microbial risk

blocks.zh: 比喻：水庫 vs. 即時供水
blocks.en: Analogy: reservoir vs. on-demand supply

blocks.zh: 儲水槽就像是一個小型水庫 — 雖然能穩定供水，但靜止的水更容易滋生微生物。就像家裡的熱水器，如果長時間不用，裡面的水質會變差。所以設計重點是：如何讓「水庫」裡的水保持流動和乾淨。
blocks.en: A storage tank is like a small reservoir - it gives a stable supply, but standing water is more prone to microbial growth. It is like a water heater at home: if it is left unused for a long time, the water quality deteriorates. So the design focus is how to keep the water in the "reservoir" moving and clean.

blocks.zh: 容量設計考量要點
blocks.en: Key points for capacity design

blocks.zh: 用水需求分析：用量、時間、頻率、同時使用的多寡
blocks.en: Water demand analysis: volume, timing, frequency, and how many users draw water at the same time

blocks.zh: 供需平衡：前處理產水速率 vs. 使用點消耗速率
blocks.en: Supply and demand balance: pretreatment production rate vs. point-of-use consumption rate

blocks.zh: 應急儲備：維護停機和緊急情況所需的最低水量
blocks.en: Emergency reserve: the minimum water volume needed for maintenance shutdowns and emergencies

blocks.zh: 泵浦保護：足夠水位避免泵浦氣蝕（cavitation）
blocks.en: Pump protection: sufficient water level to avoid pump cavitation

blocks.zh: 儲水槽設計要點
blocks.en: Key points for tank design

blocks.zh: Spray ball：噴淋球確保內表面全部潤濕，防止乾燥區域滋生微生物
blocks.en: Spray ball: ensures the entire internal surface is wetted and prevents dry areas where microorganisms can grow

blocks.zh: 夾套加熱：熱水系統必備，維持溫度防止 rouge 生成
blocks.en: Jacketed heating: essential for hot water systems; maintains temperature and prevents rouge formation

blocks.zh: 氮氣覆蓋：防止 CO₂ 吸收導致電導率上升
blocks.en: Nitrogen blanketing: prevents CO₂ absorption, which would raise conductivity

blocks.zh: 呼吸過濾器：疏水性、0.1-0.2 微米，必備！
blocks.en: Vent filter: hydrophobic, 0.1-0.2 micron, mandatory!

blocks.zh: 位置：不需要放在 GMP 潔淨區，公用設施區即可
blocks.en: Location: does not need to be in a GMP clean area; a utility area is sufficient

blocks.zh: 8.3 配水系統設計
blocks.en: 8.3 Distribution System Design

blocks.zh: 配水設計三大目標
blocks.en: Three goals of distribution design

blocks.zh: 維持水質在規格範圍內 — 注意：不是追求「零污染」，而是「在可接受範圍內」
blocks.en: Maintain water quality within specification - note: the aim is not "zero contamination" but "within acceptable limits"

blocks.zh: 在正確的流量和溫度下供水 — 使用點的需求規格
blocks.en: Deliver water at the right flow and temperature - the use point requirement specifications

blocks.zh: 最小化資本和運營成本 — 全生命週期成本
blocks.en: Minimize capital and operating costs - whole life cycle cost

blocks.zh: 重要觀念：風險導向設計（Risk-based Design）
blocks.en: Key concept: risk-based design

blocks.zh: 這段話是 ISPE 非常重要的設計哲學 — 不要盲目堆疊所有最先進的設計功能。每個設計功能都有成本，應該評估其「投資報酬率」（ROI），其中「報酬」是指「降低污染風險的程度」。
blocks.en: This passage reflects an important ISPE design philosophy - do not blindly stack every state-of-the-art design feature. Each design feature has a cost, and its "return on investment" (ROI) should be evaluated, where the "return" is the degree to which contamination risk is reduced.

blocks.zh: 範例中的 80°C 迴路系統已經有足夠的微生物控制，再加上電拋光的邊際效益很小。但如果系統開放於大氣，加裝 0.2μm 呼吸過濾器的 ROI 就非常高。
blocks.en: In the example, an 80°C loop already provides sufficient microbial control, so the marginal benefit of adding electropolishing is small. But if the system is open to the atmosphere, the ROI of adding a 0.2 μm vent filter is very high.

blocks.zh: 比喻：保險的概念
blocks.en: Analogy: the concept of insurance

blocks.zh: 這就像買保險 — 你不需要把所有險種都買齊。如果你住在沒有地震的地方，買地震險就是浪費。但如果你住在海邊，洪水險的 ROI 就非常高。設計水系統也是一樣，要根據實際風險來選擇設計功能。
blocks.en: It is like buying insurance - you do not need every type of cover. If you live where there are no earthquakes, earthquake insurance is a waste. But if you live by the sea, flood insurance has a very high ROI. Designing a water system is the same: choose design features according to the actual risks.

blocks.zh: 系統最佳化三大原則
blocks.en: Three principles of system optimization

blocks.zh: 最小化水停留在利於微生物生長條件的時間 — 溫度 15-55°C 是危險區
blocks.en: Minimize the time water spends under conditions favorable to microbial growth - 15-55°C is the danger zone

blocks.zh: 最小化水溫變化 — 每次變溫都消耗能源且可能產生溫度死角
blocks.en: Minimize water temperature changes - every temperature change consumes energy and may create temperature dead spots

blocks.zh: 消毒時接觸所有區域 — 沒有死角，每個表面都要被消毒到
blocks.en: Contact all areas during sanitization - no dead legs; every surface must be sanitized

blocks.zh: 8.3.2 配水設計概念
blocks.en: 8.3.2 Distribution Design Concepts

blocks.zh: 實務觀察
blocks.en: Practical observation

blocks.zh: 現代製藥水系統幾乎都採用動態/連續式設計。批次式是早期產水設備不可靠時的做法，現在有了線上 conductivity 和 TOC 監測，即時品質確認已經可以取代離線 QA 測試。批次式主要只在特殊合規要求下才會見到。
blocks.en: Almost all modern pharmaceutical water systems use a dynamic/continuous design. Batch operation dates from the time when water generation equipment was unreliable; now, with online conductivity and TOC monitoring, real-time quality confirmation can replace offline QA testing. Batch systems are now seen mainly under special compliance requirements.

blocks.zh: 配水系統選型三大考量
blocks.en: Three considerations in selecting a distribution system

blocks.zh: 溫度需求：使用點需要幾度的水？Hot (65-80°C)、Cold (4-10°C)、Ambient？
blocks.en: Temperature requirement: what temperature is needed at the point of use? Hot (65-80°C), Cold (4-10°C), or Ambient?

blocks.zh: 迴路架構：單迴路？平行迴路？串聯子迴路？
blocks.en: Loop configuration: single loop? parallel loops? series sub-loops?

blocks.zh: 消毒方法：蒸汽、熱水、臭氧、化學消毒 — 這會反向影響材料選擇
blocks.en: Sanitization method: steam, hot water, ozone, chemical sanitization - this feeds back into the choice of materials

blocks.zh: 8.3.3 配水決策樹
blocks.en: 8.3.3 Distribution Decision Tree

blocks.zh: 決策樹邏輯流程（Figure 8-1 描述）
blocks.en: Decision tree logic flow (Figure 8-1 description)

blocks.zh: ISPE 的決策樹幫助工程師透過回答一系列問題來選擇最佳架構：
blocks.en: The ISPE decision tree helps engineers select the best configuration by answering a series of questions:

blocks.zh: 是否需要 QA 放行？ → Yes = 批次式系統
blocks.en: Is QA release required? → Yes = batch system

blocks.zh: 使用點數量少且可頻繁沖洗？ → Yes = 分支/單向式
blocks.en: Few points of use that can be flushed frequently? → Yes = branched/single-pass

blocks.zh: 需要多種溫度？ → Yes = 平行迴路
blocks.en: Multiple temperatures needed? → Yes = parallel loops

blocks.zh: 所有使用點都需要熱水？ → Yes = 熱儲存/熱配送
blocks.en: Hot water needed at all points of use? → Yes = hot storage/hot distribution

blocks.zh: 水在常溫產出且使用？ → Yes = 常溫儲存/常溫配送
blocks.en: Water generated and used at ambient temperature? → Yes = ambient storage/ambient distribution

blocks.zh: 需要嚴格微生物控制且無暇消毒？ → Yes = 熱儲存/冷卻再加熱
blocks.en: Strict microbial control needed and no time for sanitization? → Yes = hot storage/cool and reheat

blocks.zh: 能源成本是關鍵？ → Yes = 熱槽/自含式配送
blocks.en: Is energy cost critical? → Yes = hot tank/self-contained distribution

blocks.zh: 少量低溫使用點？ → Yes = 使用點熱交換器
blocks.en: Few low-temperature points of use? → Yes = point-of-use heat exchangers

blocks.zh: 微生物控制 vs. 能源消耗的取捨
blocks.en: Microbial control vs. energy consumption trade-off

blocks.zh: 這是配水設計的核心矛盾：
blocks.en: This is the core conflict in distribution design:

blocks.zh: 最佳微生物控制 = 持續高溫 (80°C)，但能源成本最高
blocks.en: Best microbial control = continuous high temperature (80°C), but the highest energy cost

blocks.zh: 最低能源成本 = 常溫，但微生物控制最困難
blocks.en: Lowest energy cost = ambient temperature, but the most difficult microbial control

blocks.zh: 折衷方案 = 熱儲存 + 使用點冷卻，或常溫 + 定期消毒
blocks.en: Compromise = hot storage + point-of-use cooling, or ambient + periodic sanitization

blocks.zh: 冷卻設計實務提醒
blocks.en: Practical reminder on cooling design

blocks.zh: 從 80°C 冷卻到使用溫度：
blocks.en: Cooling from 80°C to use temperature:

blocks.zh: >25°C：冷卻水塔水即可（最經濟）
blocks.en: >25°C: cooling tower water is sufficient (most economical)

blocks.zh: <25°C：需要第二段冷凍水/glycol 冷卻
blocks.en: <25°C: a second cooling stage with chilled water/glycol is needed

blocks.zh: 全程用冷凍水從 80°C 降到 <25°C 不划算 — 冰機規模太大
blocks.en: Using chilled water for the whole drop from 80°C to <25°C is not economical - the chiller would be far too large
8.3.4 System Configuration Examples (1-3)

blocks.zh: 1. 批次式循環系統
blocks.en: 1. Batched recirculating system

blocks.zh: 歷史性設計 適用於產水設備不可靠需要 QA 逐批放行的場景。現在有了線上 conductivity 和 TOC，這種設計已經很少見。
blocks.en: Historical design Suited to cases where water generation equipment is unreliable and QA release of each batch is required. With online conductivity and TOC now available, this design is rarely seen.

blocks.zh: 優點：水在使用前經過完整測試
blocks.en: Advantages: the water is fully tested before use

blocks.zh: 缺點：高資本成本、操作複雜、需要至少兩個槽
blocks.en: Disadvantages: high capital cost, complex operation, at least two tanks required

blocks.zh: 2. 分支/單向式
blocks.en: 2. Branched/single-pass

blocks.zh: 高風險 最便宜但微生物控制最困難。停用時管線水滯留不動，必須建立每日沖洗和定期消毒 SOP。
blocks.en: High risk The cheapest but the most difficult for microbial control. When not in use, the water in the piping stagnates, so daily flushing and periodic sanitization SOPs must be established.

blocks.zh: 適用：預算緊、系統小、持續用水、可頻繁消毒
blocks.en: Suitable for: tight budgets, small systems, continuous water use, frequent sanitization possible

blocks.zh: 不適用：間歇用水（管線會長時間滯留）
blocks.en: Not suitable for: intermittent water use (the piping stagnates for long periods)

blocks.zh: 3. 平行迴路/單槽
blocks.en: 3. Parallel loops/single tank

blocks.zh: 常見設計 最大優勢是可以從同一個槽供應不同溫度的水。例如：一個熱迴路 + 一個冷卻再加熱迴路。
blocks.en: Common design The biggest advantage is that water at different temperatures can be supplied from the same tank. For example: one hot loop + one cool and reheat loop.

blocks.zh: 關鍵挑戰：各迴路之間的壓力和流量平衡。解決方式：壓力控制閥或各迴路獨立泵浦。
blocks.en: Key challenge: pressure and flow balance between the loops. Solutions: pressure control valves or an independent pump for each loop.

blocks.zh: 設計重點
blocks.en: Design focus

blocks.zh: ISPE 在此處強調 in-line conductivity 和 TOC 的價值 — 這些線上監測技術讓批次式系統的必要性大幅降低。這也呼應了前面「風險導向設計」的理念：用最合理的成本達到最大的品質保障。
blocks.en: ISPE emphasizes here the value of in-line conductivity and TOC - these online monitoring technologies greatly reduce the need for batch systems. This also echoes the earlier concept of "risk-based design": achieve the greatest quality assurance at the most reasonable cost.

blocks.zh: 系統架構實例（4-5）
blocks.en: System configuration examples (4-5)

blocks.zh: 4. 熱儲存 + 熱配送 — 黃金標準
blocks.en: 4. Hot storage + hot distribution - the gold standard

blocks.zh: 法規首選 這是最被法規機關認可的系統架構 — 80°C 持續循環，微生物控制最優，操作最簡單。如果你不確定選哪種，選這個就對了。
blocks.en: Regulatory first choice This is the configuration most widely accepted by regulators - continuous circulation at 80°C gives the best microbial control and the simplest operation. If you are unsure which to choose, choose this one.

blocks.zh: 5. 常溫儲存 + 常溫配送
blocks.en: 5. Ambient storage + ambient distribution

blocks.zh: 成本最低 適合水在常溫產出且使用的場景。成本最低但需要頻繁消毒。
blocks.en: Lowest cost Suited to cases where the water is generated and used at ambient temperature. Lowest cost, but requires frequent sanitization.

blocks.zh: 常溫系統消毒策略
blocks.en: Sanitization strategies for ambient systems

blocks.zh: 熱水消毒：讓水位自然下降（用掉一部分水），然後加熱剩餘的水至 80°C 循環消毒。好處是減少加熱能源。
blocks.en: Hot water sanitization: let the water level fall naturally (by using up some of the water), then heat the remaining water to 80°C and circulate it to sanitize. The benefit is reduced heating energy.

blocks.zh: 臭氧消毒（Figure 8-7）：0.02-0.2ppm 臭氧持續保護。使用前必須用 UV 完全去除臭氧。歐洲 PW 系統較常見。
blocks.en: Ozone sanitization (Figure 8-7): 0.02-0.2 ppm ozone gives continuous protection. Ozone must be fully removed by UV before use. More common in European PW systems.

blocks.zh: 化學消毒：允許使用塑膠材料（PVDF、PP），降低成本。
blocks.en: Chemical sanitization: allows the use of plastic materials (PVDF, PP), reducing cost.

blocks.zh: 比喻：游泳池 vs. 溫泉
blocks.en: Analogy: swimming pool vs. hot spring

blocks.zh: 熱系統就像溫泉 — 高溫本身就是消毒手段。常溫系統就像游泳池 — 需要額外加入消毒劑（臭氧或化學品）才能維持水質。選哪種取決於你的使用情境和預算。
blocks.en: A hot system is like a hot spring - the high temperature is itself the sanitizing means. An ambient system is like a swimming pool - a sanitizing agent (ozone or chemicals) must be added to maintain water quality. Which one to choose depends on your use situation and budget.

blocks.zh: 系統架構實例（6-8）
blocks.en: System configuration examples (6-8)

blocks.zh: 6. 熱儲存 + 冷卻再加熱
blocks.en: 6. Hot storage + cool and reheat

blocks.zh: 高能耗 微生物控制極優，消毒最簡單（關掉冷卻水即可），但能源浪費嚴重 — 不管有沒有人用水，迴路都在持續冷卻 + 再加熱。
blocks.en: High energy use Excellent microbial control and the simplest sanitization (just turn off the cooling water), but serious energy waste - whether or not anyone is using water, the loop is continuously cooled and reheated.

blocks.zh: 適用：微生物控制要求極嚴格、沒有時間消毒、多個低溫使用點、能源成本不是關鍵。
blocks.en: Suitable for: very strict microbial control requirements, no time for sanitization, multiple low-temperature points of use, energy cost not critical.

blocks.zh: 7. 熱槽 + 自含式配送
blocks.en: 7. Hot tank + self-contained distribution

blocks.zh: 能源優化版 這是架構 6 的改良版 — 冷卻後的水回到泵浦吸入側而不是回到儲水槽，避免了持續再加熱的能耗。只有實際被取用的水才需要冷卻。
blocks.en: Energy-optimized This is an improved version of configuration 6 - the cooled water returns to the pump suction side instead of to the storage tank, avoiding the energy cost of continuous reheating. Only the water actually drawn needs to be cooled.

blocks.zh: 消毒方式：關閉冷卻水，打開回到儲水槽的管路，讓熱水沖洗整個迴路。
blocks.en: Sanitization method: shut off the cooling water and open the line back to the storage tank, so that hot water flushes the entire loop.

blocks.zh: 8. 使用點熱交換器
blocks.en: 8. Point-of-use heat exchangers

blocks.zh: 高維護成本 主迴路維持熱循環（最佳微生物控制），只在需要低溫水的使用點安裝個別冷卻器。每個冷卻器都需要獨立的沖洗和消毒程序。
blocks.en: High maintenance cost The main loop remains in hot circulation (best microbial control), and individual coolers are installed only at the points of use that need low-temperature water. Each cooler requires its own flushing and sanitization procedure.

blocks.zh: 適用：少量低溫使用點 + 大量高溫使用點
blocks.en: Suitable for: a few low-temperature points of use + many high-temperature points of use

blocks.zh: 不適用：低溫使用點多（成本和空間爆炸）
blocks.en: Not suitable for: many low-temperature points of use (cost and space escalate)

blocks.zh: 練習思考：如何選擇？
blocks.en: Exercise: how to choose?

blocks.zh: 你的工廠有以下需求，應該選哪種架構？
blocks.en: Your plant has the following requirements. Which configuration should you choose?

blocks.zh: WFI 系統，水在 80°C 蒸餾產出
blocks.en: WFI system, water produced by distillation at 80°C

blocks.zh: 20 個使用點，其中 15 個需要熱水 (65°C+)，5 個需要常溫 (25°C)
blocks.en: 20 points of use, of which 15 need hot water (65°C+) and 5 need ambient (25°C)

blocks.zh: 能源成本是次要考量
blocks.en: Energy cost is a secondary consideration

blocks.zh: 微生物控制是最高優先
blocks.en: Microbial control is the top priority

blocks.zh: 參考答案：架構 8（使用點熱交換器）最適合 — 主迴路維持熱循環，只有 5 個低溫點需要冷卻器，數量不多，維護可控。
blocks.en: Reference answer: configuration 8 (point-of-use heat exchangers) is the best fit - the main loop stays in hot circulation, and only the 5 low-temperature points need coolers; the number is small and maintenance is manageable.

blocks.zh: 8.3.5 配水系統比較表解讀
blocks.en: 8.3.5 Reading the Distribution System Comparison Table

blocks.zh: Table 8-1 是系統選型的「速查表」
blocks.en: Table 8-1 is the "quick reference" for system selection

blocks.zh: 這張表是本章最具實用價值的工具。設計時可以根據你最在意的因素（微生物控制、能源、資本）來快速篩選適合的架構。
blocks.en: This table is the most practical tool in the chapter. During design, you can quickly shortlist suitable configurations based on the factor you care about most (microbial control, energy, capital).

blocks.zh: 關鍵觀察
blocks.en: Key observations

blocks.zh: 微生物控制最佳：#4 Hot/Hot（L）— 80°C 持續循環幾乎不給微生物機會
blocks.en: Best microbial control: #4 Hot/Hot (L) - continuous 80°C circulation gives microorganisms almost no opportunity

blocks.zh: 資本成本最低：#2 Branched（L）和 #4 Hot/Hot（L）
blocks.en: Lowest capital cost: #2 Branched (L) and #4 Hot/Hot (L)

blocks.zh: 能源消耗最高：#6 Cool & Reheat（H）— 持續冷卻再加熱
blocks.en: Highest energy consumption: #6 Cool & Reheat (H) - continuous cooling and reheating

blocks.zh: 操作最簡單：#4 Hot/Hot — Simple 驗證 + Simple 操作
blocks.en: Simplest operation: #4 Hot/Hot - Simple validation + Simple operation

blocks.zh: 水消耗最高：#1 Batched 和 #8 POU HX — 前者是排水換槽，後者是沖洗浪費
blocks.en: Highest water consumption: #1 Batched and #8 POU HX - the former drains and changes tanks, the latter wastes water on flushing

blocks.zh: 維護成本最高：#8 POU HX（H）— 每個使用點都有獨立的換熱器和閥門
blocks.en: Highest maintenance cost: #8 POU HX (H) - every point of use has its own heat exchanger and valves

blocks.zh: 比喻：選車
blocks.en: Analogy: choosing a car

blocks.zh: 選配水系統就像選車 — Hot/Hot 是 Toyota（可靠、簡單、法規認可），Cool & Reheat 是 BMW（性能好但油耗高），Branched 是機車（便宜但不安全），POU HX 是改裝車（靈活但維護費驚人）。沒有完美的系統，只有最適合你工況的系統。
blocks.en: Choosing a distribution system is like choosing a car - Hot/Hot is a Toyota (reliable, simple, regulator-accepted), Cool & Reheat is a BMW (great performance but high fuel consumption), Branched is a motorbike (cheap but not safe), and POU HX is a modified car (flexible but with shocking maintenance costs). There is no perfect system, only the system that best fits your operating conditions.

blocks.zh: 練習：使用比較表
blocks.en: Exercise: using the comparison table

blocks.zh: 你的場景：新建 PW 系統，預算有限，水在常溫產出，使用量穩定但不大，有充足的消毒時間。該選哪個？
blocks.en: Your scenario: a new PW system, limited budget, water generated at ambient temperature, steady but modest usage, ample time for sanitization. Which should you choose?

blocks.zh: 參考：#5 Ambient/Ambient — 資本成本 L-M，能源 L，操作 Average，只要有足夠消毒時間就能維持品質。
blocks.en: Reference: #5 Ambient/Ambient - capital cost L-M, energy L, operation Average; quality can be maintained as long as there is enough sanitization time.

blocks.zh: 8.4 建造材料
blocks.en: 8.4 Materials of Construction

blocks.zh: 材料選擇層級
blocks.en: Material selection hierarchy

blocks.zh: 藥典水（Compendial）：316L SS 首選，PVDF 也可接受
blocks.en: Compendial water: 316L SS is the first choice; PVDF is also acceptable

blocks.zh: 非藥典水（Non-compendial）：PP、PVC 可用（便宜得多）
blocks.en: Non-compendial water: PP and PVC can be used (much cheaper)

blocks.zh: 焊接品質管理要點
blocks.en: Key points for weld quality control

blocks.zh: Orbital welding 是高純水管路的首選接合方式
blocks.en: Orbital welding is the preferred joining method for high-purity water piping

blocks.zh: 同批號鋼材：相同尺寸的管件、閥門、管材應來自同一 Heat Number，避免硫含量不匹配導致焊接缺陷
blocks.en: Same heat number: fittings, valves and tubing of the same size should come from the same heat number, to avoid sulfur content mismatch causing weld defects

blocks.zh: 低碳低硫：compendial 系統必須使用低碳（L）等級
blocks.en: Low carbon, low sulfur: compendial systems must use low-carbon (L) grades

blocks.zh: 硫含量：理想 max 0.04%，但兩端匹配比絕對值更重要
blocks.en: Sulfur content: ideally max 0.04%, but matching between the two sides is more important than the absolute value

blocks.zh: 材料一致性：整個系統用同一等級（全部 316L 或全部 304L），這對鈍化程序很重要
blocks.en: Material consistency: use the same grade throughout the system (all 316L or all 304L); this matters for the passivation procedure

blocks.zh: 比喻：血管的材料
blocks.en: Analogy: the material of a blood vessel

blocks.zh: 選擇管材就像選擇人工血管的材料 — 必須與體內環境（高純水）完全相容，不能有任何東西溶出或腐蝕。316L SS 就像是經過幾十年驗證的標準材料，PVDF 是新一代的替代方案，在某些方面（如防 rouge）甚至更好，但需要特別注意熱膨脹的問題。
blocks.en: Choosing piping material is like choosing the material for an artificial blood vessel - it must be fully compatible with the environment inside the body (high-purity water), with nothing leaching or corroding. 316L SS is like a standard material proven over decades; PVDF is a newer alternative that is even better in some respects (such as rouge resistance), but special attention must be paid to thermal expansion.

blocks.zh: 8.4.1-8.4.2 材料比較與施工品質
blocks.en: 8.4.1-8.4.2 Material Comparison and Construction Quality

blocks.zh: Table 8-2 關鍵解讀
blocks.en: Key interpretation of Table 8-2

blocks.zh: PVDF 是唯一能蒸汽消毒的塑膠 — ABS、PP、PVC 都不行
blocks.en: PVDF is the only plastic that can be steam sanitized - ABS, PP and PVC cannot

blocks.zh: PVC 的 extractables 最高 — 只適合非藥典水
blocks.en: PVC has the highest extractables - suitable only for non-compendial water

blocks.zh: 所有塑膠的熱膨脹都高 — 需要大量外部支撐
blocks.en: All plastics have high thermal expansion - they need extensive external support

blocks.zh: 所有不銹鋼都有 rouge 風險 — PVDF 完全沒有
blocks.en: All stainless steels carry a rouge risk - PVDF has none at all

blocks.zh: 304L vs. 316L：316L 的耐蝕性更好（H vs. M）
blocks.en: 304L vs. 316L: 316L has better corrosion resistance (H vs. M)

blocks.zh: 施工品質管理重點
blocks.en: Key points for construction quality control

blocks.zh: 認證焊工：必須在受控環境中操作
blocks.en: Certified welders: must work in a controlled environment

blocks.zh: 專用不銹鋼加工區：避免碳鋼污染
blocks.en: Dedicated stainless steel fabrication area: avoids carbon steel contamination

blocks.zh: 焊接品質標準：光滑內徑、無凹凸、無偏移、無孔隙、無變色
blocks.en: Weld quality criteria: smooth inner diameter, no bumps or dents, no misalignment, no porosity, no discoloration

blocks.zh: 100% 射線檢測？ ISPE 認為不是必要的，也不完美 — 建議適當的抽樣檢測即可
blocks.en: 100% radiographic examination? ISPE considers it neither necessary nor perfect - appropriate sampling inspection is recommended.

blocks.zh: 這是一個很實務的觀點 — 100% 檢測既昂貴又不能保證零缺陷，合理的抽樣計劃加上良好的製程控制更有效。
blocks.en: This is a very practical view - 100% inspection is both expensive and unable to guarantee zero defects; a reasonable sampling plan combined with good process control is more effective.

blocks.zh: 練習：材料選擇決策
blocks.en: Exercise: material selection decision

blocks.zh: 場景：歐洲新建 PW 系統，使用臭氧消毒，預算有限，rouge 是客戶關切重點。
blocks.en: Scenario: a new PW system in Europe, using ozone sanitization, limited budget, and rouge is a customer concern.

blocks.zh: 你會選什麼材料？為什麼？
blocks.en: What material would you choose, and why?

blocks.zh: 參考：PVDF — 臭氧相容、無 rouge 風險、成本低 10-15%、歐洲接受度高。但必須注意熱膨脹（雖然臭氧系統通常在常溫運行，所以問題不大）。
blocks.en: Reference: PVDF - ozone compatible, no rouge risk, 10-15% lower cost, and well accepted in Europe. But thermal expansion must be considered (although ozone systems usually operate at ambient temperature, so it is not a major issue).

blocks.zh: 8.5 系統元件
blocks.en: 8.5 System Components

blocks.zh: 呼吸過濾器設計要點
blocks.en: Key points for vent filter design

blocks.zh: 材質：疏水性 PTFE 或 PVDF，0.1-0.2 μm
blocks.en: Material: hydrophobic PTFE or PVDF, 0.1-0.2 μm

blocks.zh: 尺寸：必須能應對最大進水/抽水速率
blocks.en: Size: must handle the maximum fill/draw-down rate

blocks.zh: 熱系統：必須加熱夾套防止結露阻塞
blocks.en: Hot systems: must have a heated jacket to prevent condensation blocking

blocks.zh: 蒸汽消毒：儲水槽必須能承受全真空或裝設真空保護
blocks.en: Steam sanitization: the storage tank must withstand full vacuum or be fitted with vacuum protection

blocks.zh: 完整性測試：藥典水必須做；但不需要驗證為滅菌級過濾器
blocks.en: Integrity testing: required for compendial water; but the filter does not need to be validated as a sterilizing-grade filter

blocks.zh: 泵浦設計考量
blocks.en: Pump design considerations

blocks.zh: 離心泵是標準選擇
blocks.en: Centrifugal pumps are the standard choice

blocks.zh: NPSH 計算：熱水系統必須考慮蒸氣壓
blocks.en: NPSH calculation: vapor pressure must be considered in hot water systems

blocks.zh: 泵浦發熱：低流量長時間運轉會導致冷系統升溫或熱系統氣蝕
blocks.en: Pump heating: running for long periods at low flow heats up a cold system or causes cavitation in a hot system

blocks.zh: 機械密封：雙機械密封 + WFI 沖洗（最安全）或單密封外排
blocks.en: Mechanical seals: double mechanical seal with WFI flush (safest) or single seal with external drain

blocks.zh: 備用泵：確保系統不停流
blocks.en: Standby pump: ensures the system keeps flowing

blocks.zh: 閥門趨勢
blocks.en: Valve trends

blocks.zh: 高純水系統的趨勢是使用隔膜閥（diaphragm valve）：
blocks.en: The trend in high-purity water systems is to use diaphragm valves:

blocks.zh: 可排淨（drainable）
blocks.en: Drainable

blocks.zh: 可消毒
blocks.en: Sanitizable

blocks.zh: 無死角
blocks.en: No dead legs

blocks.zh: 缺點：初始成本和維護成本較高，磨損較快
blocks.en: Disadvantages: higher initial and maintenance cost, faster wear

blocks.zh: 蒸汽服務則使用球閥（ball valve），因為隔膜在蒸汽下壽命短。
blocks.en: For steam service, ball valves are used because diaphragms have a short life under steam.

blocks.zh: 熱交換器選型
blocks.en: Heat exchanger selection

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：潔淨側（clean side）必須保持正壓，防止冷卻/加熱介質洩漏到純水側。
blocks.en: Key principle: the clean side must be kept at positive pressure to prevent the cooling/heating medium from leaking into the pure water side.

blocks.zh: 8.5.5 元件比較表解讀
blocks.en: 8.5.5 Reading the Component Comparison Table

blocks.zh: 元件選型速查指南
blocks.en: Quick guide to component selection

blocks.zh: 這張表是日常工程設計的實用參考。以下是各元件的「最佳選擇」：
blocks.en: This table is a practical reference for everyday engineering design. The "best choice" for each component is as follows:

blocks.zh: 閥門：高純水用隔膜閥，蒸汽用球閥
blocks.en: Valves: diaphragm valves for high-purity water, ball valves for steam

blocks.zh: 墊片：Teflon 或 Teflon 包覆型最安全（惰性最好）
blocks.en: Gaskets: Teflon or Teflon-enveloped types are safest (best inertness)

blocks.zh: 呼吸過濾器：0.2μm 疏水膜 + 加熱夾套（熱系統必備）
blocks.en: Vent filter: 0.2 μm hydrophobic membrane + heated jacket (essential for hot systems)

blocks.zh: 熱交換器：藥典水用 double tube sheet S&T，前處理用 P&F
blocks.en: Heat exchangers: double tube sheet S&T for compendial water, P&F for pretreatment

blocks.zh: 泵浦：離心泵為主，需要高壓時用正位移泵
blocks.en: Pumps: mainly centrifugal; positive displacement pumps where high pressure is needed

blocks.zh: 機械密封：WFI 用雙密封 + WFI 沖洗，PW 可用單密封
blocks.en: Mechanical seals: double seal with WFI flush for WFI; a single seal is acceptable for PW

blocks.zh: 連接：盡量用衛生夾具（Tri-Clamp），高壓才用法蘭
blocks.en: Connections: use sanitary clamps (Tri-Clamp) wherever possible; flanges only for high pressure

blocks.zh: 實務經驗分享
blocks.en: Practical experience

blocks.zh: Table 8-3 中最容易被忽視的是儲水槽夾套設計：
blocks.en: The item in Table 8-3 most easily overlooked is the storage tank jacket design:

blocks.zh: 半管夾套（1/2 pipe jacket）：可以從外部完整檢查槽體焊縫，這在驗證時非常重要
blocks.en: Half-pipe jacket (1/2 pipe jacket): allows the tank shell welds to be fully inspected from the outside, which is very important during validation

blocks.zh: 全夾套（full jacket）：熱效率好但焊接量大，而且槽體焊縫被遮蔽無法外部檢查
blocks.en: Full jacket: good thermal efficiency but a lot of welding, and the tank shell welds are covered and cannot be inspected from the outside

blocks.zh: 現代趨勢傾向半管夾套，因為它平衡了熱效率和可檢查性
blocks.en: The modern trend favors half-pipe jackets, because they balance thermal efficiency and inspectability

blocks.zh: 8.6 有槽 vs. 無槽系統比較
blocks.en: 8.6 Storage Tank vs. Tankless System Comparison

blocks.zh: 核心差異
blocks.en: Core differences

blocks.zh: 有儲水槽的系統提供了一個「緩衝區」和「壓力釋放點」，讓系統更穩定、更容易管理。無槽系統省了設備成本，但在操作和液壓控制上更具挑戰。
blocks.en: A system with a storage tank provides a "buffer zone" and a "pressure relief point", making the system more stable and easier to manage. A tankless system saves equipment cost, but is more challenging in operation and hydraulic control.

blocks.zh: 有儲水槽的關鍵優勢
blocks.en: Key advantages of having a storage tank

blocks.zh: Air break：防止 WFI 供水端的反向污染 — 這是衛生設計的重要概念
blocks.en: Air break: prevents back-contamination on the WFI supply side - an important concept in hygienic design

blocks.zh: Surge volume：冷卻後的 WFI 儲備量可以即時供應生產需求高峰
blocks.en: Surge volume: the reserve of cooled WFI can immediately meet production demand peaks

blocks.zh: 壓力釋放：消毒或正常通氣時有明確的壓力釋放點
blocks.en: Pressure relief: a clear pressure relief point during sanitization or normal venting

blocks.zh: 故障隔離：有問題時更容易定位和隔離
blocks.en: Fault isolation: problems are easier to locate and isolate

blocks.zh: 無槽系統的陷阱
blocks.en: Pitfalls of tankless systems

blocks.zh: 熱膨脹問題：熱水消毒時水的體積膨脹無處可去，只能排放到 drain — 浪費 WFI
blocks.en: Thermal expansion: during hot water sanitization, the expanded water volume has nowhere to go and can only be discharged to drain - wasting WFI

blocks.zh: 尖峰需求：沒有緩衝量，可能還是需要在主迴路上加槽
blocks.en: Peak demand: with no buffer volume, a tank may still have to be added to the main loop

blocks.zh: 液壓控制：無槽系統的壓力和流量管理更複雜
blocks.en: Hydraulic control: pressure and flow management is more complex in a tankless system

blocks.zh: 無槽系統的「全焊接管路」在觀感上似乎更無菌，但實際操作中，有槽系統通常更容易維持穩定的水質。
blocks.en: The "all-welded piping" of a tankless system may look more sterile, but in actual operation a system with a tank is usually easier to keep at stable water quality.

blocks.zh: 總結思考：你的工廠該選哪個？
blocks.en: Closing thought: which should your plant choose?

blocks.zh: 大多數情況下，有儲水槽的系統是更安全的選擇。無槽系統只在以下場景值得考慮：
blocks.en: In most cases, a system with a storage tank is the safer choice. A tankless system is worth considering only in the following situations:

blocks.zh: 空間極度受限
blocks.en: Space is extremely limited

blocks.zh: 資本預算非常緊張
blocks.en: Capital budget is very tight

blocks.zh: 系統小且用水量穩定（無尖峰需求）
blocks.en: The system is small and water demand is steady (no peak demand)

blocks.zh: 有經驗豐富的工程團隊管理液壓
blocks.en: An experienced engineering team is available to manage the hydraulics

blocks.zh: Section Summary | 章節總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 儲水槽是配水系統的核心，提供緩衝、壓力釋放和微生物控制。設計時需考慮容量、位置、類型（vertical/horizontal）、spray ball、夾套加熱、呼吸過濾器等。
blocks.en: The storage tank is the core of the distribution system, providing buffering, pressure relief and microbial control. Design must consider capacity, location, type (vertical/horizontal), spray ball, jacketed heating, vent filter, and so on.

blocks.zh: 8 種配水架構各有優劣 — Hot/Hot（#4）是法規最認可的黃金標準，Ambient/Ambient（#5）是最經濟的選擇，Cool & Reheat（#6）微生物控制好但能耗最高。
blocks.en: The 8 distribution configurations each have pros and cons - Hot/Hot (#4) is the gold standard most accepted by regulators, Ambient/Ambient (#5) is the most economical choice, and Cool & Reheat (#6) gives good microbial control but the highest energy consumption.

blocks.zh: 風險導向設計是本章的核心哲學 — 不是堆疊所有設計功能，而是選擇 ROI 最高的功能組合。
blocks.en: Risk-based design is the core philosophy of this chapter - do not stack every design feature, but choose the combination of features with the highest ROI.

blocks.zh: 材料選擇：316L SS 是藥典水首選，PVDF 是有競爭力的替代方案（成本低 10-15%、無 rouge、焊接更光滑），但需注意熱膨脹。
blocks.en: Material selection: 316L SS is the first choice for compendial water, and PVDF is a competitive alternative (10-15% lower cost, no rouge, smoother welds), but thermal expansion must be considered.

blocks.zh: Orbital welding 是高純水管路的首選接合方式。同批號鋼材（Heat Number 一致）對焊接品質至關重要。
blocks.en: Orbital welding is the preferred joining method for high-purity water piping. Steel of the same heat number (consistent heat number) is critical to weld quality.

blocks.zh: 系統元件：離心泵 + 隔膜閥 + double tube sheet S&T 熱交換器 + 0.2μm 疏水呼吸過濾器是標準配置。
blocks.en: System components: centrifugal pump + diaphragm valves + double tube sheet S&T heat exchanger + 0.2 μm hydrophobic vent filter is the standard configuration.

blocks.zh: 有槽 vs. 無槽：大多數場景下有儲水槽的系統更穩定、更易管理。無槽系統只在空間/資本受限的特殊場景下考慮。
blocks.en: Storage tank vs. tankless: in most scenarios a system with a storage tank is more stable and easier to manage. A tankless system is considered only in special cases where space or capital is constrained.
